transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm conducting the final round-robin check before approving the rollout policy for the AI-assisted code review feature. The feature has passed its functional tests and we're looking at a limited production rollout per the draft policy: random 10% customer cohort, telemetry stored in us-east-1 for 90 days, and expansion if adoption exceeds 20%. Before I can approve, I need to hear from security, customer support, and data science. Please share any required policy revisions or concerns you have so we can get them recorded in the rollout ticket. Once we've covered all required revisions, I'll settle the decision.

transcript.text: I need to flag a required policy revision. transcript.text: I need to flag a required policy revision on the customer support side. transcript.text: I need to flag a required policy revision on the security side. The settlement decisions must reflect eu-central-1 as the telemetry region, exactly 7 days retention, and encryption — rather than the draft values of us-east-1, 90 days, and no encryption. I have not yet attached the classification note to the launch document, so that also needs to be done or assigned as a follow-up commitment. This needs to be recorded as a required revision in the rollout ticket before approval.

transcript.text:
